res.label: Residential frontage
res.desc: Acres of A1/B1/B2 parcels on the face. Bins on the curb, residents needing parking.

com.label: Commercial frontage
com.desc: Acres of F1 parcels. Dumpsters, customers, deliveries, late activity.

trash311.label: Trash-related 311
trash311.desc: Trash, dumping, missed pickup, nuisance cases within 300 ft.

parking311.label: Parking-related 311
parking311.desc: Parking violation and meter complaints within 300 ft.

missed.label: Missed collections
missed.desc: Solid Waste missed-pickup exceptions logged at the face.

roadkill.label: Dead-animal pickups
roadkill.desc: Solid Waste dead-animal collection calls at the face. Danger signal.

trees.label: Big-tree proxy
trees.desc: 311 tree trim/removal requests. Canopy, denning, shade.

adt_low.label: Quiet street
adt_low.desc: Inverse of traffic volume (1 = no traffic).

restricted.label: Permit-restricted
restricted.desc: Any residential permit or PBD restriction during the week.

vacant.label: Vacant lots
vacant.desc: Acres of vacant parcels (C1/C2) on the face.

stop_ctl.label: Stop sign / signal nearby
stop_ctl.desc: Traffic control within 100 ft; no-parking-near-intersection rule proxy.

flood.label: Flood zone
flood.desc: 1 = FEMA special flood hazard area (AE), 0.5 = 500-yr, 0 = outside.

bike_lane.label: Bike lane on face
bike_lane.desc: Existing bikeway within 40 ft; replaces curb parking.

meters.label: Meter transactions
meters.desc: Pay-by-plate occupancy by space and hour. Turns pressure from model into measurement.

waymo.label: Robotaxi pickup/dropoff density
waymo.desc: Rideshare curb demand by block and hour.

foot_traffic.label: Foot-traffic panel
foot_traffic.desc: Anonymized visits by venue and hour.

satellite.label: Daily satellite imagery
satellite.desc: Count parked cars from orbit, daily revisit.

tabc.label: Licensed bars & restaurants
tabc.desc: TABC licenses geocoded to the face (public, needs geocoding work).

raccoon_bachelor.label: 🦝 Bachelor raccoon — quick dinner
raccoon_bachelor.blurb: Bins on the curb the night before garbage day, plus restaurant dumpsters. Eat and leave.

raccoon_family.label: 🦝🦝🦝 Raccoon family — settle down
raccoon_family.blurb: Dependable weekly supply (garbage AND recycling nights), quiet streets, big trees to den in, low roadkill risk.

raccoon_date_night.label: 🦝💘 Raccoon looking for a mate
raccoon_date_night.blurb: Go where the other raccoons are: highest trash density, late, near the bars. Bring a snack.

raccoon_buffet.label: 🦝🛋️ Heavy-trash buffet
raccoon_buffet.blurb: Monthly heavy-trash service: couches, fridges, mystery bags. Yard waste night as a chaser.

human_resident_11pm.label: 🚗 Resident, home at 11 PM
human_resident_11pm.blurb: Residential frontage with room, quiet street, away from commercial spillover, late evening.

human_delivery_driver.label: 📦 Delivery driver, needs a curb
human_delivery_driver.blurb: Commercial frontage, capacity, no bus stop in the way, off-peak hours.

human_311_hotspot.label: 🏛️ City ops — where do complaints stack?
human_311_hotspot.blurb: Parking complaints + missed collections + illegal dumping on the same face. One crew, one trip.

food_truck_friday.label: 🌮 Food truck, Friday night
food_truck_friday.blurb: Commercial frontage, room to park a truck, foot traffic implied by bars, not a bus stop, not a bike lane.

homebuyer_quiet_dry.label: 🏠 Homebuyer: quiet and dry
homebuyer_quiet_dry.blurb: Residential street, low traffic, out of the floodplain, parks and trees nearby, not a nightlife spillover block.

city_ops_one_truck.label: 🚛 City ops: one truck, most fixes
